caption: The drawing is rendered in grayscale with fine lines and shading. The central object is a lidded pitcher or teapot, featuring a bulbous lower body, a narrow neck, a wide spout on the left, and a curved handle on the right. The lid is dome-shaped with a pointed finial on top. The pitcher is framed by a rectangular border. In the upper-left corner of the rectangle, there is an inset showing a series of concentric circles, and in the lower-right corner, another inset depicts a smaller, simplified outline of the main pitcher with labeled dimensions “A” and “B.” Below the central rectangle, there is a name written: "MATTHEW MANGACOTTI." The composition is set on a plain, light background, and all elements are outlined and shaded in black pencil or ink.
title: Pewter Water Pitcher
